description: Use this to record an expense. amountCents is in minor units of currency (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250). paidByParticipantToken is who paid; splits lists who shares it. For an even split use splitType equal and omit amountCents from the splits. Take participant tokens from get_group or search, and default the date to today.

SplitInput.description:
`amountCents` is each participant's share. With `splitType: equal`
it may be omitted from every split, and the server divides the
amount evenly (leftover cents go to the first participants). A split
of zero leaves that participant out; no zero split is stored.

amountCents.description: This member's share in minor units of the expense's currency.

participantToken.description: A member who shares the expense, by token from `showGroup`.

SplitType.description:
How a transaction's amount is divided across participants.
  • `equal` — equal shares across all listed participants.
  • `percentage` — percentage shares (sum to 100, server normalizes
    rounding cents).
  • `shares` — weighted shares (e.g. 1, 2, 1 → 25/50/25 split).
  • `amount` — exact per-participant amounts supplied by the client.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

amountCents.description: The total in minor units of `currency` (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250).

categoryToken.description: The group category to file it under, by token from `showGroup`. Omit for none.

currency.description:
The currency it was paid in. One other than the group's is converted into
the group currency at the rate on `date`.

description.description: What the expense was for, as the group will see it.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who paid, by token from `showGroup`.

splitType.description:
How the total is divided. `equal` divides it for you; for any other type
each split carries its own `amountCents`.

splits.description:
Who shares the expense. For `equal`, list the members and omit `amountCents`:
the server divides the total, odd cents to the first members in the group's
order. For `amount`, `percentage` and `shares`, give each member's
`amountCents`; they must add up to the total (exactly for `amount`, otherwise
within 1 per member).

timeOfDay.description: Time of day, `HH:MM` (24-hour). Omit for the time it is recorded, in Japan time.
